scope: One supervised genuine FlexGEMM import followed by one genuine CPU parent-decoder load; no forwards, GPU tensors, native binding calls, O-Voxel child construction, builds, installs or retries.
review_method: Read-only inspection of the complete candidate, existing loader and policy sources, pinned genuine parent source, cpu-probe-4 parameter manifest, preflight and preservation JSON. No candidate execution, Torch/model import, WSL action or checkpoint payload read by this reviewer. Only this review JSON was written.

loader_identity.factory_instrumentation: Times the existing factory under StrictLocalComponent's existing meta-device context; neither changes the constructor nor replaces the loader.
loader_identity.state_contract: 292 original F16 checkpoint entries, strict complete keys/shapes/dtypes/devices and byte equality, then exactly 76 byte-exact F16/F32/F16 widenings; final 216 F16 and 76 F32, CPU only, zero buffers, eval and gradients disabled.

memory_arithmetic_bytes.arithmetic_limit: Live payload calculations exclude runtime/native-library overhead, mmap/page-cache residency and allocator retention. Admission is a conservative budget, not a formal process RSS ceiling.

checks.exclusive_marker_and_output: Fresh marker absent and run directory absent at review; base.save_json opens the marker with x and flushes/fsyncs, preventing reuse; fresh run and guest scratch also reject existing paths.
checks.admission: 6972719480-byte host and guest floor; fresh guest RAM read directly before loading; host RAM and D free-space checks repeat every second; 5 GiB guest disk and 50 GiB D-disk floors preserved.
checks.observability: CPU VmRSS, VmHWM and ru_maxrss before loading, while loaded and after release; existing factory, total load/widen and complete CPU-stage timings recorded; final primitive parameter manifest and zero buffers recorded.
checks.cleanup: Strong local factory references cleared; explicit model/component unload and GC; independent weakrefs require model, component and every parameter to disappear. Existing owned Windows Job plus named guest termination and post-exit healthy observation remain required for qualification.
checks.forbidden_execution: Unchanged pinned tensor, runtime, native-call, forward, compiler/helper, filesystem and autotuner policy remains installed across native import and CPU loading; zero GPU allocation/reservation peaks and final rejected/native-call counts are required.
checks.source_or_import_failure: Any exception exits the single attempt with UNKNOWN evidence; no repair or retry path exists.

go_limit: This decision covers only the candidate hash above and exactly one supervised attempt. It provides no forward, GPU placement, mesh/O-Voxel, build, helper or retry authorization.
